item.title: Top 10 AI use cases on X, Nov 19 2026
item.description:

    With early access, he spent a day building in Google's Antigravity with Gemini 4 Neon, which produced 17 interactive demos, from shooters to 3D worlds. His thread shares eight of them plus coding and tool-use tests, and what went right and wrong.

    @kimmonismus on X · 986 likes · 34 reposts · 97,099 views

    @analogalok on X · 73 likes · 2 reposts · 16,333 views
